propositions: Link-sync tests exercise only a single representative relation (blocks) instead of the full relation vocabulary, leaving unmapped relations (depends_on, relates_to, duplicates, supersedes, discovered_from) uncovered and enabling direction-swap bugs like c8ed to ship.
The outbound _diff_links emission logic must be parametrized over all 6 relations with assertions on the exact (jira_type, swap) tuple for mapped relations and empty mutations for unmapped relations.

The REMOVE path's inward/outward direction logic (outbound_links.py:193-202) lacks test coverage for the case where an outward Blocks link is removed and must emit a mutation with action=remove and relation=depends_on.
Test assertions must validate per-relation orientation (e.g., swap=True for depends_on) rather than mere presence, so that regressions in direction handling are caught.
